spine.zh: 标普七连跌与金价周跌

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (23 November). Friday closes, the weekly drops, October personal-income tax at 89.6%, and the margin cut.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月23日）。周五收盘、周跌幅、10月个人所得税89.6%，以及融资保证金调整。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (21 November). Nvidia at 125.5, Hang Seng Tech at 3511.14, LME copper at 12160, bitcoin at 58951, and the dollar index at 103.817.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月21日）。英伟达125.5美元，恒生科技指数3511.14，伦铜12160美元，比特币58951美元，美元指数103.817。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (23 November). Goldman on the selloff, Nasdaq 100 futures up as much as 2.6%, and an early Kospi drop with Tokyo closed.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月23日）。高盛对这次抛售的看法，纳斯达克100期货一度上涨2.6%，韩国综指早盘下跌且东京休市。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (22 November). The margin floor goes from 100% to 80% on 30 November, alongside fee relief and a ChiNext market-making draft.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月22日）。融资保证金下限从100%调至80%，11月30日起施行，同时还有降费和创业板做市征求意见。

influence.en: Yicai (21 November). The same Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq closes, December gold at 3515.40, and December WTI at 83.98.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月21日）。同一组道指、标普500和纳斯达克收盘，12月黄金3515.40美元，12月WTI 83.98美元。

influence.en: Yicai (23 November). The first 18 active ETFs list today, and the Tokyo cash market is closed.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月23日）。首批18只主动ETF今日上市，东京股市休市。

influence.en: Caixin (23 November). October fiscal revenue rose 3.4% from a year earlier, and the Nasdaq fell 5.28%.
influence.zh: 财新（11月23日）。10月财政收入同比增长3.4%，纳斯达克下跌5.28%。

influence.en: Xinhua (22 November). The margin floor falls from 100% to 80% on 30 November, with a theoretical increment near 400 billion yuan.
influence.zh: 新华社（11月22日）。融资保证金下限从100%降至80%，11月30日起实施，理论上增量资金近4000亿元。

influence.en: US Treasury curve for 20 November. The 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.31%. On 19 November they were 4.76%, 5.04%, and 5.40%.
CNBC live blog. Friday closes for the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and Dow, spot gold at 3520.05, and bitcoin below 60000 dollars.
influence.zh: CNBC直播博客。周五标普500、纳斯达克和道指收盘，现货黄金3520.05美元，比特币跌破60000美元。

influence.en: BlockBeats (22 November). Bitcoin at 59593 dollars, up 1.76% over 24 hours on the HTX quote.
influence.zh: 律动（11月22日）。HTX报价下比特币59593美元，24小时上涨1.76%。

influence.en: CICC (15 November). The dollar's rise came from officials' hawkish turn, and a 25 basis point December increase was fully in the price then.
influence.zh: 中金（11月15日）。美元走强来自官员的鹰派转向，当时12月加息25个基点已经完全计入价格。

influence.en: Glassnode (17 November). Realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月17日）。已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。

influence.en: 23 November 财经早茶. The AI unwind, the margin cut, Iran, and the gold import chart.
influence.zh: 11月23日财经早茶。人工智能交易瓦解、融资保证金下调、伊朗，以及黄金进口这张图。

title.en: Gold imports make the goods surplus look smaller
title.zh: 黄金进口让货物顺差看起来更小

analysis.en: The dark line, which leaves gold out, ends at about 7 percent of GDP. The pale line, which keeps gold in, ends at about 5.6 percent. The gap is wider than in early 2025, so the published balance understates the goods gap.
analysis.zh: 剔除黄金的深色线终点大约在GDP的7%。保留黄金的浅色线终点大约在5.6%。缺口比2025年初更宽，所以公布的顺差低看了货物缺口。

marketTone.en: US stocks fell hard, and the S&P 500 dropped for a seventh day into a correction. Gold had its largest weekly drop in eight months.
marketTone.zh: 美股大跌，标普500连续第七日下跌并进入回调。黄金录得八个月来最大单周跌幅。

text.en: The Dow fell 1.93% to 48147.33, the S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6910.39, a seventh straight drop, and the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22617.73. For the week the Dow fell 8.02%, the S&P 500 fell 8.61%, and the Nasdaq fell 10.02%, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：道指下跌1.93%至48147.33，标普500下跌3.70%至6910.39，连续第七日下跌，纳斯达克下跌5.28%至22617.73。全周道指下跌8.02%，标普500下跌8.61%，纳斯达克下跌10.02%。

text.en: Nvidia fell 14% to 125.5 dollars, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 10.73%. Anthropic fell 8.5% to 88.91 dollars, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：英伟达下跌14%至125.5美元，费城半导体指数下跌10.73%。Anthropic下跌8.5%至88.91美元。

text.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.31%. On 19 November they were 4.76%, 5.04%, and 5.40%.
COMEX December gold settled at 3515.40 dollars, down 4.62%. December WTI rose 0.93% to 83.98 dollars, and January Brent rose 0.64% to 92.57 dollars, 第一财经 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 第一财经、华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金结算价3515.40美元，下跌4.62%。12月WTI上涨0.93%至83.98美元，1月布伦特上涨0.64%至92.57美元。

text.en: Shanghai fell 1.22% to 3533.79, Shenzhen fell 3.09% to 10256.39, and the ChiNext fell 3.54% to 2212.13. Turnover was above 1.43 trillion yuan. The Hang Seng fell 1.89% to 22410.80, and Hang Seng Tech fell 3.78% to 3511.14, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证指数下跌1.22%至3533.79，深证成指下跌3.09%至10256.39，创业板指下跌3.54%至2212.13，成交超过1.43万亿元。恒生指数下跌1.89%至22410.80，恒生科技指数下跌3.78%至3511.14。

text.en: The Nikkei 225 fell 5.1% to 56436.65, and the Kospi fell 5.2% to 4869.96, 华尔街见闻 reported. Bitcoin fell 4.8% to 58951 dollars.

signal.en: The AI unwind took US stocks into a correction, and Treasury yields fell even while a December increase stayed likely.
signal.zh: 人工智能交易的瓦解把美股带进了回调，国债收益率下降了，12月加息仍然较有可能。

watch.en: Eurozone and UK PMI flashes are this afternoon. The US PMI flash is at 22:45 Beijing. Pill speaks at 21:00. The margin cut takes effect on 30 November. PBOC bills are tendered in Hong Kong on 24 November.
watch.zh: 欧元区和英国PMI初值在今天下午。美国PMI初值在北京时间22:45。Pill在21:00讲话。融资保证金调整在11月30日生效。央行票据在11月24日于香港招标。

title.en: The S&P 500 fell for a seventh day into a correction

fact.en: The Dow fell 1.93% to 48147.33, the S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6910.39, a seventh straight drop and more than 10% below its October high, and the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22617.73, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported. Nvidia fell 14% to 125.5 dollars, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 10.73%, 华尔街见闻 reported. Anthropic fell 8.5% to 88.91 dollars, 第一财经 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：道指下跌1.93%至48147.33，标普500下跌3.70%至6910.39，连续第七日下跌，且较低点回落超过10%，纳斯达克下跌5.28%至22617.73。华尔街见闻：英伟达下跌14%至125.5美元，费城半导体指数下跌10.73%。第一财经：Anthropic下跌8.5%至88.91美元。

mechanism.en: The seventh down day took the S&P 500 more than 10% below its October high, so the AI unwind is now a correction. Goldman (23 November): the selloff is a chance to add risk, but positions are still high, so a full washout may still lie ahead. US stocks are the market that fell.
mechanism.zh: 连续第七日下跌，把标普500带到了10月高点下方超过10%的位置，所以人工智能交易的瓦解现在是一次回调。高盛（11月23日）：这次抛售是增加风险的机会，但仓位仍然偏高，彻底的出清可能还在后面。下跌的是美股。

title.en: Yields fell hard as December hike odds were marked down
title.zh: 12月加息概率下调，收益率大降

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.31%. On 19 November they were 4.76%, 5.04%, and 5.40%. The odds of a 25 basis point increase in December fell to 91.4%, and the odds of 50 basis points by the end of January fell to 57.7%, 第一财经 reported.
fact.zh: 美国财政部：2年期收益率4.63%，10年期4.92%，30年期5.31%。11月19日分别为4.76%、5.04%和5.40%。第一财经：12月加息25个基点的概率降至91.4%，到1月底累计加息50个基点的概率降至57.7%。

mechanism.en: Yields fell on a day when traders marked down the December increase, so the haven bid showed up in bond prices. CICC (15 November): officials' hawkish turn had lifted the dollar, and a December increase of 25 basis points was fully in the price then. The 10-year yield fell to 4.92%.
mechanism.zh: 交易员下调12月加息的这一天，收益率下降了，避险买盘体现在债券价格上。中金（11月15日）：官员的鹰派转向推高了美元，当时12月加息25个基点已经完全计入价格。10年期收益率降到了4.92%。

title.en: December gold fell 4.62% in an eight-month weekly drop
title.zh: 12月黄金下跌4.62%，周跌幅为八个月最大

fact.en: COMEX December gold settled at 3515.40 dollars an ounce, down 4.62%, 第一财经 reported. Spot gold fell 2.81% to 3520.05 dollars, and the week was the worst in eight months, CNBC reported.
fact.zh: 第一财经：COMEX 12月黄金结算价每盎司3515.40美元，下跌4.62%。CNBC：现货黄金下跌2.81%至3520.05美元，这一周是八个月来最差的一周。

mechanism.en: A 4.62% drop in the December contract extended the selloff, and the week was the largest in eight months. 财经早茶 (23 November): the hike outlook pulled gold down. Gold is the market that fell.
mechanism.zh: 12月合约下跌4.62%，把跌势又延伸了一步，这一周是八个月来最大的一周。财经早茶（11月23日）：加息前景拖累了黄金。下跌的是黄金。

title.en: Crude rose on Friday and still fell for a third week
title.zh: 原油周五上涨，仍连跌第三周

fact.en: December WTI rose 0.93% to 83.98 dollars a barrel, and January Brent rose 0.64% to 92.57 dollars, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported. For the week, WTI fell 5.17% and Brent fell 3.41%, a third straight down week, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻、第一财经：12月WTI上涨0.93%至每桶83.98美元，1月布伦特上涨0.64%至92.57美元。华尔街见闻：全周WTI下跌5.17%，布伦特下跌3.41%，连续第三周下跌。

mechanism.en: Friday's settle rose, while the week fell for a third time, so the strike risk did not hold in the weekly price. 财经早茶 (23 November): traders are weighing another US strike on Iran against ample supply. December WTI closed at 83.98 dollars.
mechanism.zh: 周五的结算价上涨了，这一周却是第三次下跌，所以打击风险没有留在周度价格里。财经早茶（11月23日）：交易员在美国再次打击伊朗的风险和充裕的供应之间权衡。12月WTI收在83.98美元。

title.en: London copper fell to its lowest since March

fact.en: LME three-month copper fell 366 dollars to 12160 dollars a tonne, and the session low of 12020 was the lowest since 24 March, 华尔街见闻 reported. The week was down about 9.3%.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜下跌366美元至每吨12160美元，盘中低点12020美元，为3月24日以来最低。全周下跌约9.3%。

mechanism.en: London copper fell to its lowest since March, so the prior session's steadying did not last. 财经早茶 (23 November): the AI unwind pulled metals lower with it. Copper is the market that made that low.
mechanism.zh: 伦铜跌到了3月以来的最低，所以上一个交易日的企稳没有延续。财经早茶（11月23日）：人工智能交易的瓦解把金属一起带低了。创下这个低点的是铜。

title.en: European stocks had their biggest weekly drop since April 2025
title.zh: 欧洲股市创2025年4月以来最大周跌幅

fact.en: The STOXX 600 fell 2% to 625.65, and it fell 5.80% on the week, the largest weekly drop since April 2025, 华尔街见闻 reported. The DAX fell 2.60% to 24802.78, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：STOXX 600下跌2%至625.65，全周下跌5.80%，为2025年4月以来最大周跌幅。德国DAX下跌2.60%至24802.78。

mechanism.en: European stocks had their biggest weekly drop since April 2025, and German bonds rose in the same week. 财经早茶 (23 November): the tech selloff fed haven demand for German bonds. European stocks and German bonds are the markets that moved.
mechanism.zh: 欧洲股市创下2025年4月以来最大的周跌幅，德国国债在同一周上涨。财经早茶（11月23日）：科技股抛售给德国国债带来了避险需求。跟着动的是欧洲股市和德国国债。

title.en: Bitcoin fell below 60000 as an ETF outflow hit a record
title.zh: 比特币跌破60000，ETF流出创纪录

fact.en: Bitcoin fell 4.8% to 58951 dollars and traded below 60000, 华尔街见闻 and CNBC reported. BlackRock's spot bitcoin ETF had a one-day net outflow of 541 million dollars, the largest since the 2024 listing, 华尔街见闻 reported. On 22 November it stood at 59593 dollars, up 1.76% over 24 hours, 律动 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻、CNBC：比特币下跌4.8%至58951美元，并跌破60000美元。华尔街见闻：贝莱德现货比特币ETF单日净流出5.41亿美元，为2024年上市以来最大。律动：11月22日比特币报59593美元，24小时上涨1.76%。

mechanism.en: Friday's drop went through 60000 dollars, and a large ETF outflow landed on the same day. Glassnode (17 November): realized losses had reached a level seen only near past cycle lows. Bitcoin pays no interest, and it fell with US stocks.
mechanism.zh: 周五的下跌穿过了60000美元，同一天出现了大额ETF流出。Glassnode（11月17日）：已实现亏损已经达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。比特币不产生利息，跟着美股下跌。

title.en: Hong Kong tech fell as the Nvidia sales probe widened
title.zh: 港股科技下跌，英伟达销售调查扩大

fact.en: The Hang Seng Tech index fell 3.78% to 3511.14, and the Hang Seng fell 1.89% to 22410.80, 华尔街见闻 reported. The SEC is reviewing Nvidia's accounting, and California is looking at advanced chip sales to China, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：恒生科技指数下跌3.78%至3511.14，恒生指数下跌1.89%至22410.80。财经早茶、华尔街见闻：美国证券交易委员会正在审查英伟达的会计，加州也在调查向中国出售先进芯片的问题。

mechanism.en: Hong Kong tech shares fell while the probe of chip sales widened, so the control story and the price moved together. 财经早茶 (23 November): Bessent urged a full check of chip sales, and orders for H200 chips from China are scarce. Hang Seng Tech is the market that fell.
mechanism.zh: 港股科技下跌的同时，芯片销售的调查扩大了，所以管制这件事和价格一起动了。财经早茶（11月23日）：贝森特要求彻查芯片销售，中国对H200芯片的订单很少。下跌的是恒生科技指数。

title.en: Exchanges cut the financed-buying margin floor to 80%
title.zh: 交易所把融资保证金下限降到80%

fact.en: The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing exchanges will cut the minimum margin for financed stock purchases from 100% to 80% on 30 November, Xinhua and 华尔街见闻 reported. Xinhua said the change could theoretically free nearly 400 billion yuan.
fact.zh: 新华社、华尔街见闻：沪深北交易所将把融资买入股票的最低保证金比例从100%降至80%，11月30日起实施。新华社称，这次调整理论上可带来近4000亿元增量资金。

mechanism.en: A lower minimum lets the same collateral support a larger financed purchase, and open contracts can be recalculated on the new ratio. 财经早茶 (23 November): the three exchanges moved after Chinese stocks stayed under pressure. A-shares are the market the rule is aimed at.
mechanism.zh: 更低的下限让同样的担保品可以支持更大的融资买入，未了结的合约也可以按新比例重算。财经早茶（11月23日）：三大交易所是在中国股市持续承压之后行动的。这条规则对着的是A股。

title.en: The yuan firmed while the dollar still rose on the week
title.zh: 人民币走强，美元全周仍上涨

fact.en: The ICE dollar index fell 0.08% to 103.817 on Friday and rose 0.39% on the week, a fourth straight up week, 华尔街见闻 reported. Onshore yuan finished the night session at 6.6714 per dollar, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：ICE美元指数周五下跌0.08%至103.817，全周上涨0.39%，连续第四周上涨。在岸人民币夜盘收于1美元兑6.6714。

mechanism.en: The yuan firmed on a day when haven trades favored the yen and the Swiss franc, and the dollar index still rose over the week. 财经早茶 (23 November): the dollar index recovered its intraday loss as those haven trades lifted the yen and the franc. The yuan is the rate that firmed on the day.
mechanism.zh: 避险交易偏向日元和瑞郎的这一天，人民币走强了，美元指数全周仍然上涨。财经早茶（11月23日）：这些避险交易推高日元和瑞郎时，美元指数收回了盘中的失地。当天走强的是人民币。

title.en: Gold imports make the measured goods surplus look smaller
title.zh: 黄金进口让测到的货物顺差更小

fact.en: Gold imports jumped this year and pushed the measured goods surplus down, while the surplus with gold removed is a larger share of GDP, 财经早茶 reported. The surplus is on track to top 1 trillion dollars for a second straight year.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：今年黄金进口激增，压低了测到的货物顺差，剔除黄金之后的顺差占GDP的比重更大。货物顺差有望连续第二年超过1万亿美元。

mechanism.en: Gold imports sit inside the goods bill, so the published surplus is smaller than the surplus with gold removed. 财经早茶 (23 November): those imports jumped this year and can keep weighing on the measured surplus. This reading did not set Friday's yuan price.
mechanism.zh: 黄金进口记在货物账里，所以公布的顺差小于剔除黄金之后的顺差。财经早茶（11月23日）：这些进口今年跳增，还可能继续压低测到的顺差。这个读数没有决定周五的人民币价格。

text.en: The S&P 500 is well below its October record as worry about an AI unwind spread.
text.zh: 标普500指数自10月纪录高点下跌逾10%，人工智能交易瓦解的担忧席卷华尔街。

text.en: The Golden Dragon index fell for a fifth day. Baidu and NetEase were the biggest drags.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数五连跌，百度和网易对指数拖累最大。

text.en: Treasuries rose sharply as investors left technology stocks.
text.zh: 美债大涨，投资者撤离科技股提振避险需求。

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index recovered its intraday loss. Haven trades lifted the yen and the Swiss franc.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数收复盘中失地，避险交易推动日元和瑞郎上涨。

text.en: German bonds rose as the global technology selloff fed haven demand. European stocks had their biggest weekly drop since April 2025.
text.zh: 德国国债上涨，全球科技股抛售提振避险需求。欧洲股市创2025年4月以来最大周跌幅。

text.en: Oil fell for a third straight week as traders weighed another US strike on Iran against ample supply.
text.zh: 油价连续第三周下跌，交易员在美国再次打击伊朗的风险与充裕的原油供应之间进行权衡。

text.en: Copper fell to its lowest since March as the AI unwind sparked a broad metal selloff. The hike outlook gave gold its largest weekly drop in eight months.
text.zh: 铜价跌至3月以来最低水平，人工智能交易瓦解引发金属市场普遍抛售。美联储加息前景拖累黄金创八个月最大单周跌幅。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks fell into a correction, and the S&P 500 dropped for a seventh day. Treasury yields fell as traders marked down a December increase. Gold had its largest weekly drop in eight months, while crude rose on Friday and still fell for a third week.
globalRegime.zh: 美股进入回调，标普500连续第七日下跌。交易员下调12月加息之后，国债收益率下降。黄金录得八个月来最大周跌幅。原油周五上涨，仍连跌第三周。

text.en: The AI trade unwound. The Nasdaq 100 had its worst week since March 2020 and is near a bear market. The S&P 500 sits well below its October high. MSCI emerging-market stocks entered a bear market, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：全球人工智能交易迅速瓦解。纳斯达克100指数创2020年3月以来最差单周表现，逼近熊市。标普500指数明显低于10月高点。MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌入熊市。

text.en: Goldman's volatility fear gauge was near an extreme on Friday. The trading desk sees a tactical entry in US stocks, but positions are still high, the Fed is expected to keep raising rates, and doubts about AI returns remain, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：高盛的波动率恐慌指数上周五接近历史极值。交易部门认为美股接近战术性买点，但仓位仍然偏高，美联储料将继续加息，人工智能投资回报的疑虑还在。

text.en: SpaceX is raising debt to buy AI chips, and the yield on the main bonds is above 8%, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：SpaceX为采购人工智能芯片进行债务融资，主要债券收益率超过8%。

text.en: Nvidia is at an 18-month low and nearly half its October high. Reuters said US regulators are looking at its accounting. California is also looking at whether Nvidia illegally sold advanced chips to China and misled investors, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英伟达股价创18个月新低，较10月高点已近腰斩。路透称美国监管机构在调查其会计。加州也在调查英伟达是否违法向中国出售先进芯片并误导投资者。

text.en: The US director of national intelligence said the Justice Department is investigating former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang and her firm. Treasury secretary Bessent urged Nvidia to review its chip sales, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国国家情报总监表示，司法部正在调查Megaspeed前高管Alice Huang及其公司。财长贝森特敦促英伟达彻查芯片销售。

text.en: Fed governor Cook warned that waiting to raise rates could force a larger tightening later. The Philadelphia Fed president favors a careful pace and is willing to act at a string of coming meetings, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美联储理事库克警告，若延迟加息，未来可能需要更大幅度地收紧。费城联储行长主张以审慎步伐加息，并愿意在接下来的会议上连续行动。

text.en: Bessent warned that tightening too far on the latest inflation data could hurt the economy, and that the financial system is showing fragile spots, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：贝森特警告，若因最新通胀数据过度收紧，可能危及美国经济，并指出金融体系出现脆弱迹象。

text.en: The stock drop led traders to mark down hike bets for this year. Swap markets are no longer sure the Fed will raise rates in December, and haven demand lifted Treasuries on Friday, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：股市下跌促使交易员下调年内加息押注。互换市场不再笃定美联储12月会加息。避险情绪推动美国国债周五上涨。

text.en: After a Sunday emergency meeting, senior Korean officials said they will prepare a stock stabilization fund in stages and relax daily buyback limits for three months, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：韩国高层金融官员周日紧急会议后说，将分阶段准备股市稳定基金，并把上市公司每日回购限额放宽三个月。

text.en: Iran's foreign minister said the stockpile dispute can be solved if highly enriched uranium stays in the country. Trump told Fox he is still talking with Tehran indirectly and would rather resume strikes after the new year if there is no deal, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊朗外长表示，在高浓缩铀不运出境的前提下，库存争端有可能找到办法。特朗普对福克斯新闻说，目前仍在与德黑兰间接对话，若达不成协议，他倾向于新年后再恢复打击。

text.en: US trade representative Greer said the Section 301 probe of global industrial overcapacity will be finished before year-end. That can raise trade tension before the US-China truce expires in January, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国贸易代表格里尔表示，针对全球工业产能过剩的301调查会在年底前完成。这可能在美中休战明年1月到期前加剧贸易紧张。

text.en: Trump threatened a heavy tax on US firms that build data centers abroad. He said a trade deal with Mexico is close, and that more work remains with Canada. Greer called Canada's warmer trade ties with China a step backward, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普威胁对在海外建设数据中心的美国企业征收重税。他说美国接近与墨西哥达成贸易协议，与加拿大仍有更多工作要做。格里尔称加拿大缓和对华贸易关系是倒退。

text.en: OpenAI's chief scientist called for limits on more capable models until researchers can understand and monitor them. Chief executive Altman agreed, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：OpenAI首席科学家呼吁，在研究人员能更好理解和监控之前，对能力更强的模型设限。首席执行官Altman表示赞同。

text.en: CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler. A deal would create a firm worth about 265 billion dollars, one of the largest in cybersecurity, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：CrowdStrike据悉洽谈收购Zscaler。若成交，合计市值约2650亿美元，会是网络安全行业最大的交易之一。

text.en: Russia rejects putting Ukraine's NATO membership into a peace deal, including a quasi-member option. Poland said two Russian missiles and one jet-powered drone fell in eastern Poland on Friday, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：俄罗斯反对把乌克兰加入北约写进和平协议，准成员方案也不接受。波兰称，两枚俄罗斯导弹和一架喷气动力无人机周五坠落在波兰东部。

text.en: The University of Michigan sentiment final rose to 51.5 from 48.0 in October. The one-year inflation expectation fell to 3.7% from 4.7%, and the longer-run expectation fell to 3.3% from 3.5%, 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 第一财经：密歇根大学消费者信心指数终值升至51.5，10月为48.0。一年期通胀预期从4.7%降至3.7%，长期通胀预期从3.5%降至3.3%。

text.en: Nasdaq 100 futures rose as much as 2.6% in Asian hours, while the Kospi fell more than 3% early and Tokyo was shut for a holiday, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：亚洲时段纳斯达克100期货一度上涨2.6%，韩国综指早盘下跌超过3%，东京因假期休市。

text.en: If December odds keep falling, the dollar's weekly rise can fade even if officials still talk about higher rates.
text.zh: 若12月加息的概率继续下降，美元这一周的上涨可能褪去，即便官员仍在谈更高的利率。

text.en: If the stock drop spreads past chips, Friday's bond rally can extend, because that rally came from leaving technology shares.
text.zh: 若股价下跌扩散到芯片以外，周五的债券上涨还可以延续，因为那次上涨来自资金离开科技股。

text.en: If talks with Iran fail and strikes resume after the new year, the third weekly drop in crude can reverse.
text.zh: 若与伊朗的谈判失败、新年后恢复打击，原油连续第三周的下跌可能反过来。

globalTensions.en: Bonds rose while stocks fell. Gold fell with stocks, so it did not act as a shelter on Friday. Crude rose on the day and fell on the week. Tokyo is closed Monday, the Kospi opened lower, and US futures bounced.
globalTensions.zh: 债券上涨，股票下跌。黄金跟着股票下跌，周五没有起到避风的作用。原油当天上涨、全周下跌。周一东京休市，韩国综指低开，美国股指期货反弹。

chinaStance.en: The three exchanges cut the financed-buying margin after a weak Friday, while the loan prime rate stayed unchanged. The budget surplus is a one-off personal-tax gain.
chinaStance.zh: 三大交易所在疲弱的周五之后下调了融资保证金，贷款市场报价利率则维持不变。财政盈余来自一次性的个人所得税。

text.en: The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing exchanges will cut the minimum margin for financed stock purchases from 100% to 80% on 30 November, Xinhua and 华尔街见闻 reported. Xinhua said that could theoretically free nearly 400 billion yuan.
text.zh: 新华社、华尔街见闻：沪深北交易所将把融资买入证券的最低保证金比例从100%降至80%，11月30日起实施。新华社称，理论上可带来近4000亿元增量资金。

text.en: Taiwan's financial regulator banned short sales below the prior close. The national security fund said it has entered the market to steady local shares, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾金管会全面禁止平盘以下放空。台湾国安基金表示已经进场稳定台股。

text.en: The Taiwan exchange discussed lowering the maintenance ratio on financed share purchases with local brokers, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾证券交易所与本地券商讨论降低融资买入股票的担保维持率。

text.en: October brought the first budget surplus in a year, as a one-off personal-tax jump from offshore wealth offset higher spending, 财经早茶 reported. October personal income tax rose 89.6%, January-October stamp duty rose 54.1%, and land-sale revenue fell 25.8%, 华尔街见闻 reported. October fiscal revenue rose 3.4% from a year earlier, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：10月广义政府收入高于支出，一年来首次盈余，离岸财富的一次性个人所得税抵消了支出回升。华尔街见闻：10月个人所得税同比增长89.6%，1至10月印花税增长54.1%，土地出让收入同比下降25.8%。财新：10月财政收入同比增长3.4%。

text.en: The goods surplus is on track to top 1 trillion dollars for a second year, but gold imports make the measured surplus look smaller, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：货物贸易顺差有望连续第二年超过1万亿美元，但黄金进口让测到的顺差看起来更小。

text.en: The securities regulator told some law firms it will not approve certain red-chip listings outside the mainland, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：证监会告知部分律师事务所，不会批准一些红筹企业到内地以外上市。

text.en: Hang Seng Tech will expand from 30 names to 50 names, effective 7 December, including CATL and Luxshare, 财经早茶 and 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、华尔街见闻：恒生科技指数成分股将从30只增加到50只，12月7日生效，纳入宁德时代和立讯精密等公司。

text.en: Taiwan's October export orders rose at a record pace, and the third-quarter current-account surplus was the second highest on record, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾10月外销订单同比增速创纪录。第三季经常帐顺差为历年单季次高。

text.en: Taiwan's central bank said exporters kept selling dollars as the trade surplus grew, even with a wider rate gap versus the US, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾央行表示，即便台美利差扩大，出口商仍在卖出美元，卖汇金额随顺差扩大而增加。

text.en: Bessent said China wants its own chips and that orders for Nvidia's H200 are scarce. He said the leaders agreed that superintelligence should not take major military action on its own, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：贝森特表示，中国寻求自主芯片，对英伟达H200的订单很少。他说元首们同意，超级智能不应自主实施重大军事行动。

text.en: The planning agency urged faster spending on government investment projects. China will also expand rules for token-based computing services, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：发改委敦促加快政府投资项目的建设和资金支付。中国还将完善词元服务的计量和测评规范。

text.en: The loan prime rate was unchanged for an 18th month, at 3% for one year and 3.5% for five years, 华尔街见闻 reported. The first 18 active ETFs list today, and the Tokyo cash market is closed, 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：贷款市场报价利率连续第18个月不变，1年期3%，5年期以上3.5%。第一财经：首批18只主动ETF今日上市，东京股市休市。

text.en: If investors use the lower margin, financed buying can rise into a market that just had a weak Friday. The theoretical 400 billion yuan is not cash that has arrived.
text.zh: 若投资者用上更低的保证金，融资买入可能增加，而市场刚刚经历了一个疲弱的周五。理论上的4000亿元还不是已经到来的资金。

text.en: If the personal-tax jump does not repeat, the October surplus can disappear even if the margin rule stays easier.
text.zh: 若个人所得税的跳增不再出现，10月的盈余可能消失，即便保证金规则仍然更松。

chinaDivergences.en: Officials eased financing rules over the weekend after A-shares and Hong Kong shares fell on Friday. The yuan firmed even as the dollar rose on the week. The published goods surplus is smaller than the surplus with gold imports removed.
chinaDivergences.zh: 周五A股和港股下跌之后，官员在周末放宽了融资规则。美元全周上涨，人民币却走强。公布的货物顺差小于剔除黄金进口之后的顺差。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 23 November, through next Friday, 4 December. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy decision falls in these dates. After the November switch to standard time, a decision at 14:00 US Eastern is 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月23日到下周五12月4日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息决定。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。

event.zh: 英国央行首席经济学家Pill讲话

event.zh: 融资保证金下限80%开始实施

note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。
